round: V33 step 1: screen five-cell pattern sets for stage 3 by fitting realised scores
status: frozen before data collection and any fit
motivation: Stage 3 (6144 -> 12288) did not improve with retraining (V27), lower rates (V28), the V29 five-cell shapes (V31) or strong-search episodes (V32). This step asks, cheaply, whether other pattern shapes describe stage-3 positions better before any TD training.

data.policy: W31 website search (5-ply, cutoff 0.01, clamp) to 12288 or death
data.model: training/v31-stages/models/W31.bin + residuals V30 P-final.res, V31 S1-final.res, V31 S3-final.res
data.starts: training/v27-stage3/pools/train-onpolicy.txt (14,956 stage-3 training starts; never an evaluation pool)
data.target: G = realised future score after the afterstate (same reward definition as the TD trainers)

fit.base: dist/models/ntuple-v23.bin stage 3 (= V21 S3 four-cell table, standalone), fixed
fit.split: validation = records whose start index % 5 == 0 (both passes of a start together)
fit.sgd: multiplicity-normalised, 4 shuffled epochs at .003/.001/.0003/.0001, seed 33; best validation epoch reported

candidateNotes.C2: P5 plus four more five-cell shapes (8 patterns, 32 MB per stage)
candidateNotes.C3: six-cell shapes from 2048 programs, informational only (not deployable on the web)

comparison: per validation start index, sum of squared errors; paired difference vs P5 across start indices: mean, SE, z. Relative gain = (MSE_P5 - MSE_X) / (MSE_NONE - MSE_P5).
decision: Go to TD training (a separate, later protocol) with the better of C1/C2 only if it beats P5 with z > 2 and relative gain >= 5%. If neither does, stop: pattern shape is not the stage-3 bottleneck under this proxy. C3 is reported but cannot trigger the go decision.
